_comment: Nemotron-H (`NemotronHForCausalLM`, mlx-lm `nemotron_h.py`): one pre-norm block per layer, its mixer picked by `hybrid_override_pattern` — `M` Mamba-2, `*` attention (GQA, NO RoPE), `E` MoE (sigmoid + e_score_correction_bias routing, non-gated relu2 experts + relu2 shared expert), `-` dense relu2 MLP. The pattern derives the `mamba_layers` / `attention_layers` / `moe_layers` / `mlp_layers` sets the DSL branches on. The decoder tree is `backbone.*` (`backbone.embeddings`, `backbone.layers.N.{norm,mixer.*}`, `backbone.norm_f`), not `model.*`; every mixer sits under `mixer`, which the DSL names per kind (`attn` / `mamba` / `moe`) so each kind keeps its own accessor. Norm eps is `layer_norm_epsilon`.
